title: Cleansing the Stones
description: Storn Crag-Strider asks the player to cleanse the remaining All-Maker Stones on Solstheimâ€”Beast, Earth, Sun, and Waterâ€”using the Bend Will shout to free the island from Miraak's influence.

base_facts: I am the shaman of the Skaal village.
The All-Maker Stones have been corrupted by Miraak's influence.
Cleansing the remaining stones may slow Miraak's progress even if it does not stop him entirely.
The Wind Stone has already been freed from Miraak's control.

QUEST_STARTED: I have asked the traveler to cleanse the Beast, Earth, Sun, and Water Stones using the Bend Will shout.
ALL_STONES_CLEANSED: The four sacred Stones—Beast, Earth, Sun, and Water—have been cleansed of Miraak's corruption.
The Tree Stone alone remains imprisoned within Miraak's temple, beyond the reach of the Bend Will shout.
Those who were enslaved at the stones have regained their will and returned to their homes and lives.
The All-Maker's blessings flow once more through the cleansed stones, granting their powers to those who seek them.

beats.comment: Storn directs the player to cleanse the remaining four All-Maker Stones. Stage 5 fires with the objective to cleanse the Water Stone.
All four stones cleansed. Quest completes at stage 200. Solstheim is freed from Miraak's influence except for the Tree Stone.
